package fusionbridge

import (
 "context"
 "errors"
 "os"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/nmxmxh/ovasabi_foundation/runtime-sdk/go/runtimehost"
 "github.com/nmxmxh/ovasabi_foundation/server-kit/go/metadata"
 "github.com/nmxmxh/ovasabi_foundation/server-kit/go/placement"
 "github.com/nmxmxh/ovasabi_foundation/server-kit/go/security"
)

func prontoFoundationBinding(tb testing.TB) (context.Context,*runtimehost.FFIPool,*placement.BindingRegistry,placement.RuntimeBindingRequest,[]byte) {
 tb.Helper()
 pool,err:=runtimehost.NewFFIPool(runtimehost.FFIPoolOptions{LibraryPath:os.Getenv("PRONTO_FUSION_LIB"),Workers:1})
 if err!=nil{tb.Fatal(err)}
 tb.Cleanup(func(){if err:=pool.Close();err!=nil{tb.Error(err)}})
 payload,err:=EncodeKernelRequest(OpRecessionProbit,[]float64{0.76},nil);if err!=nil{tb.Fatal(err)}
 ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),30*time.Second);tb.Cleanup(cancel)
 ctx=security.ContextWithOrganizationID(ctx,"binding-reference")
 md:=metadata.New();md.CorrelationID="pronto-native-binding";ctx=metadata.IntoContext(ctx,md)
 registry,err:=placement.NewBindingRegistry(1,placement.BindingLimits{Resources:1,Bindings:1,ResidentBytes:4096,InFlight:1},
  func(context.Context,placement.BindingAction,uint64,uint64)error{return nil},
  placement.BindingType{ID:1,Validate:func(data []byte)error{if len(data)!=len(payload){return placement.ErrBindingInvalid};return nil}},
  placement.BindingType{ID:2,Validate:func(data []byte)error{_,err:=DecodeKernelResponse(data);return err}})
 if err!=nil{tb.Fatal(err)}
 tb.Cleanup(func(){if err:=registry.Close();err!=nil{tb.Error(err)}})
 if _,err:=registry.PublishResource(ctx,1,1,0,payload);err!=nil{tb.Fatal(err)}
 spec,err:=runtimehost.NewFFIBinding(pool,"pronto.fusion.v1",placement.BindingSpec{ID:1,ResourceID:1,ResourceGeneration:1,InputTypeID:1,OutputTypeID:2,MaxInputBytes:uint64(len(payload)),MaxOutputBytes:128,MaxConcurrency:1})
 if err!=nil{tb.Fatal(err)}
 request,err:=registry.Bind(ctx,spec,0);if err!=nil{tb.Fatal(err)}
 return ctx,pool,registry,request,payload
}

func TestFoundationNativeResourceBinding(t *testing.T) {
 ctx,_,registry,request,_:=prontoFoundationBinding(t)
 output:=make([]byte,128)
 receipt,err:=registry.Execute(ctx,request,"pronto-native-binding",output);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 values,err:=DecodeKernelResponse(output[:receipt.OutputBytes])
 if err!=nil||len(values)!=1||values[0]<0.149||values[0]>0.151{t.Fatalf("native oracle: %v %v",values,err)}
 if receipt.InputCopiedBytes!=request.MaxInputCopyBytes||receipt.InputCopiedBytes==0{t.Fatal("native copy was concealed")}
 request.MaxInputCopyBytes=0
 if _,err:=registry.Execute(ctx,request,"pronto-native-binding",output);!errors.Is(err,placement.ErrBindingBudget){t.Fatal(err)}
}

func BenchmarkFoundationNativeBinding(b *testing.B) {
 ctx,pool,registry,request,payload:=prontoFoundationBinding(b)
 output:=make([]byte,128)
 if _,err:=registry.Execute(ctx,request,"pronto-native-binding",output);err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}
 b.Run("ffi-direct",func(b *testing.B){b.ReportAllocs();for b.Loop(){if _,err:=pool.ExecuteInto(ctx,runtimehost.ProcessRequest{UnitID:"pronto.fusion.v1",Input:payload},output);err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}}})
 b.Run("ffi-binding",func(b *testing.B){b.ReportAllocs();for b.Loop(){if _,err:=registry.Execute(ctx,request,"pronto-native-binding",output);err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}}})
}
